header: Traceability aid only. Not a compliance claim, not qualification, not certification.
purpose: List which fields the Metalliksa run report and qualification dossier record, and which records the named documents ask for that the dossier does not carry. It is a gap list. It does not state that any document is satisfied.
pathConvention: Paths are relative to the dossier object (createLpbfQualificationReport). Scope 'dossier' paths are checked against a real dossier by tests/standards-traceability.test.ts. Scope 'run-report-extras' paths (extras.*) live in LpbfRunReportExtras (buildJob, machineCalibration) and scope 'run-report-options' in LpbfRunReportOptions; the test checks that the last segment of those appears in the run report or machine calibration source. '[]' marks an array element.

coverageMeaning.recorded: The dossier or run report carries the field with an explicit value or an explicit unavailable marker. It says nothing about whether the value meets any requirement.
coverageMeaning.partially recorded: A related field exists but it is free text, user-typed, assumed, simulated or lacks parts the document topic implies.

schemaMdTiers: docs/archive/SCHEMA.md describes a 5-tier Build, ProcessParams, Sample, Properties, Source chain. The run dossier does not instantiate that chain. It carries build context (tier 1, partly), the process vector (tier 2, partly), a specimen (tier 3, partly), simulated W/D/L instead of measured properties (tier 4) and research evidence as opaque JSON (tier 5). SCHEMA.md fields with no dossier counterpart: powder size distribution and atomization, chamber atmosphere, plate location, measured density and tensile properties, testing standards, lab.

documents.title: Additive Manufacturing Requirements for Spaceflight Systems
documents.verification: Read from the public PDF. Section numbers and requirement identifiers (AMR-n) were checked against its table of contents and body. No clause text is quoted.

documents.title: Laser Powder Bed Fusion Process
documents.verification: Title and one-line purpose (process controls for repeatable L-PBF production of aerospace parts) from the public SAE listing. Clause numbers and record requirements: unverified: check against a licensed copy.

documents.title: AMS7000: L-PBF produced parts, nickel alloy 62Ni-21.5Cr-9.0Mo-3.65Nb, stress relieved, HIP and solution annealed. AMS7001: nickel alloy powder for additive manufacturing (same composition). AMS7002: Process requirements for production of metal powder feedstock for use in additive manufacturing of aerospace parts.
documents.verification: Titles from public press coverage of the 2018 SAE release. Relevant here mainly for AMS7002 (powder feedstock records). AMS7000 and AMS7001 are nickel alloy 625 specific and outside the Ti64/AlSi10Mg primary scope. Clause numbers: unverified: check against a licensed copy.

documents.title: Standard Specification for Additive Manufacturing Nickel Alloy (UNS N07718) with Powder Bed Fusion
documents.edition: F3055-14a in public listings (also -14, -14e1). Edition currency: unverified: check against a licensed copy
documents.verification: Title and topic list from the ASTM store page and third-party listings: ordering information, manufacturing plan, feedstock, thermal processing, chemical composition, microstructure, mechanical properties, hot isostatic pressing, supplementary requirements S1 to S16. Clause numbers: unverified: check against a licensed copy.

documents.title: Standard Specification for Additive Manufacturing Titanium-6 Aluminum-4 Vanadium ELI (Extra Low Interstitial) with Powder Bed Fusion
documents.verification: Designation and title only, from public listings. Scope topics and clause numbers: unverified: check against a licensed copy.

documents.title: Standard for Additive Manufacturing, Finished Part Properties, Specification for AlSi10Mg with Powder Bed Fusion, Laser Beam
documents.verification: Designation and title from the ASTM additive manufacturing catalogue and volume listings. One third-party database listed a different alloy for this number, so confirm the title on a licensed copy. Scope topics and clause numbers: unverified: check against a licensed copy.

documents.title: Standard for Additive Manufacturing, Finished Part Properties, Standard Specification for Titanium Alloys via Powder Bed Fusion
documents.verification: Title and one-line scope (full-melt PBF of titanium alloys, wrought-like properties) from the ANSI webstore listing. Clause numbers: unverified: check against a licensed copy.

documents.title: Additive manufacturing, General principles, Fundamentals and vocabulary
documents.edition: Second edition, 2021-11 (the 2015 first edition was titled Terminology)
documents.verification: Designation, title and edition from the ISO catalogue page. A vocabulary standard: it asks for no records, so it is used only to check that dossier wording uses standard terms. Clause numbers: unverified: check against a licensed copy.

gaps.item: Powder characterisation: size distribution, shape, chemistry, cleanliness, handling and storage, supplier certificate, reuse count and blend
gaps.ref: 5.4.1 (AMR-38, AMR-39); 6.6 (AMR-66); 5.4.2 (AMR-40) names these as key variables
gaps.note: Only a lot string and a free-text condition exist.

gaps.item: Machine serial number, firmware and software versions, equipment and facility control plan reference
gaps.note: Only a machine model string exists.

gaps.item: Chamber atmosphere, oxygen level, gas flow, humidity, dwell and pause times between layers
Build control parameter file name and cryptographic hash; hashes of build file, tool path and other digital-thread files
gaps.note: The dossier hash covers the dossier only.

gaps.item: Tool path settings beyond a scan strategy label: area fill scheme, rotation, start/stop sequence, distribution across the build area
Process restart criteria and unplanned interruption records
Structured post-processing record: thermal process times, temperatures and atmosphere, HIP, machining, support and platform removal
gaps.note: Heat treatment is one free-text string.

gaps.item: Part or specimen serialization and traceability to the build; location on plate
Witness specimens and statistical process control data
In-situ process monitoring data
Nondestructive evaluation records
Part classification and rationale; AM control plan, qualified material process, material property suite and part process references
gaps.note: By design the dossier does not carry program authority decisions.

gaps.item: Measured finished-part properties: density or porosity, microstructure, tensile and hardness, with test standard, specimen geometry, orientation and heat treatment
gaps.note: Only simulated melt-pool dimensions and a user-typed melt-pool draft exist. The properties tier of docs/archive/SCHEMA.md is not part of the dossier.

gaps.item: Build orientation and anisotropy evaluation
gaps.note: Only a model incline angle exists.

gaps.item: Test lab identity, instrument and calibration, operator, dates, approvals and signatures
gaps.ref: 4.4; 4.14 (AMR-30) names operators, dates and revisions as process metadata
